disabled.description: Indicates whether the webhook is disabled.

displayName.description: Required. The human-readable name of the webhook, unique within the agent.

genericWebService.description: Configuration for a generic web service.

allowedCACerts.description: Optional. Specifies a list of allowed custom CA certificates (in DER format) for HTTPS verification.

httpMethod.description: Optional. HTTP method for the flexible webhook calls. Standard webhook always uses POST.

oauthConfig.description: Optional. The OAuth configuration of the webhook.

clientID.description: Required. The client ID provided by the 3rd party platform.

clientSecret.description: Optional. The client secret provided by the 3rd party platform.

scopes.description: Optional. The OAuth scopes to grant.

tokenEndpoint.description: Required. The token endpoint provided by the 3rd party platform to exchange an access token.

serviceAgentAuth.description: Optional. Indicate the auth token type generated from the Dialogflow service agent.
